newsitem.title: USA: Visioneer names StreamLogic CEO as chair.
newsitem.headline: Visioneer names StreamLogic CEO as chair.

text.p: Visioneer Inc said late Monday that it has named J.Larry Smart as chairman.
Visioneer said Smart will remain chairman, president and chief executive of StreamLogic Corp after taking his new job at Visioneer.
The company provided no informtaion about a previous chairman and could not be immediately reached for comment.
Visioneer recently reported a fourth-quarter loss of $0.58 per share after charges, compared to the year-ago quarter profit of $0.03 per share.

StreamLogic recently announced that it would take more than $1 million in restructuring costs during the next two quarters. It reported earnings of $0.81 per share after a $1.02 gain for the third quarter ended December 27, compared with a $1.63 loss in the year-ago quarter.
